findings.evidence: `ProbabilityMeasureExt.lean:64-67` states the reused lemma as `Measurable fun P => (P s : ℝ)`, while `ProbabilityMeasure.lean:131-136` defines `P s` via `((P : Measure α) s).toNNReal`; the goals at Moments.lean:338, 387, and 411 instead contain the measure evaluation followed by `.toReal`.
findings.fix: Use `(measurable_directingMass h.measurable_directing hB).ennreal_toReal`, or add an explicitly proved helper whose conclusion has the exact `.toReal` form and use it at all three sites.
findings.issue: Lines 339, 388, and 412 use a lemma concluding measurability of `(ν ω B : ℝ)` to prove measurability of `((ν ω : Measure α) B).toReal`, relying silently on unfolding the `ProbabilityMeasure` function coercion through `toNNReal`.

summary: The real-valued measurability replacements rely on undocumented definitional equality between two different evaluation interfaces.
